reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, which is nice, but there are zero reviews and I read the 1-star reviews first. I already have a magnesium that works for me and I am not going to be the first person to test a new brand.
objection: No reviews at all, so I cannot check complaints about stomach upset, capsule size or whether the dose is real. A lab report is the brand's own claim, and $1 a day is more than I pay now for something I already know works.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred reviews with a decent share of verified buyers and few complaints about stomach or capsule size, or a doctor I trust recommending this specific brand.
